in_sanskrit.name: विभव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विभवः (Vibhavaḥ) is a Sanskrit name which means 'Prosperity', 'Fortune', or 'Wealth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word विभव (Vibhavaḥ) which means 'manifestation', 'appearance', or 'display'. This name is often used in Hindu mythology to refer to various gods and goddesses who are believed to bestow prosperity and good fortune upon their devotees.

in_hindi.name: विभव
in_hindi.long_meaning: विभव (Vibhav) is a Hindi name which means 'Fertile', 'Productive', or 'Prosperous'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word विभव (Vibhavaḥ) which means 'manifestation', 'appearance', or 'display'. This name is often used in Hindu culture to signify prosperity and good fortune.

in_tamil.name: விபவ

This name is often used in Tamil culture to signify the abundance of blessings and good fortune.
